records.d: Arthur Eddington proposed in 1920 that stars shine by fusing hydrogen: the fusion idea was born. The sun became a reactor. The power source was named.
records.h: Eddington reasoned that proton fusion could power stars. The hypothesis was theoretical. The idea was stellar.
records.mj: Established - documented 1920 Eddington proposal; stellar fusion hypothesis.

records.d: Mark Oliphant's team fused deuterium in 1934: the first laboratory fusion. The reaction worked on Earth. The lab made star-stuff.
records.h: Accelerator-driven deuterium fusion released energy in the Cavendish. The reaction was real. The lab was stellar.
records.mj: Established - documented 1934 Oliphant experiments; first laboratory fusion.

records.d: Hans Bethe worked out fusion cycles in 1938: how stars actually burn. The physics was solved. The Nobel followed in 1967.
records.h: Bethe detailed the proton-proton chain and CNO cycle. The stellar engine was understood. The prize was earned.
records.mj: Established - documented Bethe cycles; 1967 Nobel Prize.

records.d: Britain's ZETA claimed fusion in 1957, then retracted: the first fusion hype cycle. The lesson was humility. The field learned to verify.
records.h: ZETA's neutrons proved to be instability, not fusion. The retraction was public. The lesson was verification.
records.mj: Established - documented 1957 ZETA; claimed then retracted fusion.

records.d: The Soviet T-3 tokamak's 1968 results proved the tokamak worked: the magnetic bottle held. The field had a path. The tokamak won.
records.h: T-3 achieved temperatures far beyond rivals. The tokamak design dominated. The path was magnetic.
records.mj: Established - documented 1968 T-3; tokamak breakthrough.

records.d: Europe built JET from 1978: the world's largest tokamak. The scale was continental. The machine was the bet.
records.h: JET's construction culminated in first plasma in June 1983. The device was huge. The bet was European.
records.mj: Established - documented JET; first plasma June 1983.

records.d: JET ran deuterium-tritium in November 1991: the first controlled fusion power. The fuel burned. The milestone was DT.
records.h: The DT experiments produced fusion power, a world first. The fuel was real. The power was controlled.
records.mj: Established - documented November 1991; first controlled DT fusion.

records.d: Princeton's TFTR hit 10.7 MW in 1994: the American record. The power grew. The race was transatlantic.
records.h: The tokamak produced record fusion power. The achievement was American. The race was on.
records.mj: Established - documented 1994 TFTR; 10.7 MW fusion power.

records.d: JET set 16 MW in October 1997: the magnetic fusion record that stood decades. The bar was set. The record endured.
records.h: The 16.1 MW pulse was the peak of magnetic fusion. The record lasted. The bar was high.
records.mj: Established - documented October 1997; 16 MW JET record.

records.d: Seven parties signed ITER in November 2006: the world builds a burning plasma. The project was planetary. The tokamak was global.
records.h: The agreement launched construction in France. The cost was shared. The plasma would burn.
records.mj: Established - documented November 2006 agreement; ITER organization.

records.d: The National Ignition Facility completed in 2009: 192 lasers for inertial fusion. The laser was the star-maker. The facility was the bet.
records.h: NIF's 192 beams targeted fusion ignition. The scale was unprecedented. The bet was inertial.
records.mj: Established - documented 2009 NIF completion; 192-beam laser facility.

records.d: NIF achieved fuel gain in September 2013: fusion outpaced the fuel's energy. The milestone was scientific. The gain was real.
records.h: The experiments showed more fusion energy than the fuel absorbed. The result was published. The gain was fuel-level.
records.mj: Established - documented September 2013; NIF fuel gain.

records.d: Wendelstein 7-X achieved first plasma in December 2015: the stellarator worked. The twisty bottle held. The alternative lived.
records.h: The optimized stellarator confined plasma. The design was German. The alternative was viable.
records.mj: Established - documented December 2015; W7-X first plasma.

records.d: Commonwealth Fusion Systems spun out of MIT in 2018: the startup for compact fusion. The magnet was the breakthrough. The company was private.
records.h: CFS bet on high-temperature superconducting magnets for compact tokamaks. The funding was venture. The approach was startup.
records.mj: Established - documented 2018 founding; CFS MIT spinout.

records.d: NIF hit 1.3 MJ in August 2021: the near-ignition shot. The threshold neared. The lasers almost lit the star.
records.h: The experiment produced 1.3 megajoules, nearing ignition. The result electrified. The threshold was close.
records.mj: Established - documented August 2021; NIF 1.3 MJ shot.

records.d: CFS demonstrated its HTS magnet in September 2021: the strongest fusion magnet. The bottle got stronger. The compact path opened.
records.h: The 20-tesla magnet test succeeded. The field was record. The tokamak could shrink.
records.mj: Established - documented September 2021; CFS 20T HTS magnet.

records.d: NIF achieved ignition on December 5, 2022: more fusion energy out than laser energy in. The star was lit. The milestone was historic.
records.h: The 3.15 MJ shot exceeded the 2.05 MJ laser input. The announcement was global. The ignition was real.
records.mj: Established - documented December 5, 2022; NIF ignition.

records.d: NIF repeated ignition in July 2023: the star lit twice. The result was reproducible. The physics was solid.
records.h: The repeat shot confirmed ignition. The science was repeatable. The solid was the physics.
records.mj: Established - documented July 2023; repeated NIF ignition.

records.d: JET's final deuterium-tritium campaign ran in late 2023: the record machine's farewell. The tokamak retired a champion. The era closed.
records.h: DTE3 set energy records before shutdown. The farewell was scientific. The champion retired.
records.mj: Established - documented 2023 DTE3; JET final campaign.

records.d: Fusion labs pushed yields higher in 2024: the record yields. The yields are the record. The 2024 is the pushed.
records.h: Ignition shots repeated with gains. The record are the yields. The pushed is the 2024.
records.mj: Established - documented 2024 NIF; repeated ignition yields.

records.d: CFS built SPARC in 2024: the net-energy tokamak rising. The compact machine grew. The demonstration neared.
records.h: Construction advanced on the net-energy device. The schedule was aggressive. The demo was coming.
records.mj: Emerging - real construction; CFS SPARC net-energy tokamak.

records.d: Helion advanced in 2024: the pulsed fusion startup with a Microsoft power deal. The contract was signed. The startup had a customer.
records.h: The Microsoft PPA targeted fusion power delivery. The deal was historic. The customer was real.
records.mj: Emerging - real agreement; Helion Microsoft power purchase deal.

records.d: Private fusion funding passed $7 billion by 2024: the industry was capitalized. The startups were funded. The race was private.
records.h: Venture and corporate money backed dozens of fusion companies. The field was crowded. The capital was real.
records.mj: Emerging - real investment; private fusion funding wave.

records.d: Fusion milestones accumulated in 2025: private devices hitting plasma records. The field advanced. The energy was coming.
records.h: Multiple companies reported progress. The momentum was real. The coming was the energy.
records.mj: Emerging - real milestones; 2025 private fusion progress.
